EMPIRICAL INTRAVENOUS REGIMENS WITH VANCOMYCIN
Discontinue vancomycin after 3 days unless culture results indicate that continued therapy is needed. Contact Hematology-Oncology or Infectious Diseases for advice.

[References](references)

Hughes WT Clin Infect Dis 2002, 34: 730
Rolston KVI Clin Infect Dis 2004, 39: S44
Sipsas NV  Cancer 2005, 103: 1103
Therapy:
## Inpatient

### Preferred treatment

Cefepime 2g IV q12h ($$) [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h ($) [DI] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg q12h ($)[R]
<OR>
Ceftazidime 2 gm IV q8h ($$) [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h ($) [DI]
<AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg q12h ($)[R]

## ER/UC

### Preferred treatment

Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($6/day) R <AND> cefepime 2 gm IV q8h

($35/DAY) [R]

Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h ($33/day) R <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg

IV q12h ($6.00/day) [R] < OR >
Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 gm IV q6h ($33/day) R <AND> gentamicin 5
mg/kg IV q24h ($3/day) [R] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg q12h ($6.00/day) [R]

### Alternatives for penicillin allergy

Aztreonam 2 gm IV q8h ($50/day) <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h

($6/day) [R] < OR >
Aztreonam 2 gm IV q8h ($50/day) <AND> gentamicin 5 mg/kg IV q24h ($3/day)

[R] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h ($6.00/day) [R]

*Local guidance (Des Moines CDSS, ER/UC):*
Cefepime 2 g IV once STAT ($$) [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT ($) [DI] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV once STAT ($) [R]
<OR>
Ceftazidime 2 gm IV once STAT ($$) [R] <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV once STAT ($) [DI] <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV once STAT ($) [R]
Inpt: ORZID2 GMENU EMP INTRAV W/ VANCO
ERUC: ORZID GMENU ER/UC EMP INTRAV W/ VANCO
